pr_title: Use getter return type for the property type
pr_body:
The PropertyInfo hints are more relevant for the inspector. The getter return type is more reliable and less likely to be incorrect and it is what's going to be called in the end.

Fix #42280
pr_comments: Now that release builds have type info this passes the CI.

issue_context.title: GDScript: error when assigning Material to any property of type Material derived from GeometryInstance3D
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:**
4.0 master - 80399781100796ea62184a2a908fc7fe23b27303


**Issue description:**
When assigning a Material, such as Material, StandardMaterial3D, BaseMaterial3D, ShaderMaterial, to a property of type Material, such as GeometryInstance3D's 'material_override', GPUParticles3D's 'process_material', it will throw an error similar to:
Cannot assign a value of type "StandardMaterial3D" to a target of type  "ShaderMaterial,StandardMaterial3D"

The console will also output something like "Cannot get class 'ShaderMaterial,StandardMaterial3D'."


**Steps to reproduce:**
```
func test():
	var mat: StandardMaterial3D = StandardMaterial3D.new() # Material, BaseMaterial3D, ShaderMaterial - also error
	var mesh : MeshInstance3D = MeshInstance3D.new() # GeometryInstance3D, GPUParticles3D - also error
	mesh.material_override = mat # Error here
```

Pics:
![1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/68266227/94051981-3ad0aa80-fdd0-11ea-94a2-d857d3035edd.PNG)
![2](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/68266227/94051988-3d330480-fdd0-11ea-9f71-63de5db5f47b.PNG)
![3](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/68266227/94051991-3efcc800-fdd0-11ea-9833-338893a202b4.PNG)
comments: Confirming issue still exists in 4.0 Master  13th May 2021

I wonder if the property usage hint is wrong. For example look at the material property in PrimitiveMesh 
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/b283447bfd5c8d1f6a6566bda57f89c1b87a3e0e/scene/resources/primitive_meshes.cpp#L210

Compared with material override
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/b283447bfd5c8d1f6a6566bda57f89c1b87a3e0e/scene/3d/visual_instance_3d.cpp#L392

Interesting, I tried modifying the property hints to match the primativemesh as per your suggestion, but it didn't work. So I tried to assign a StandardMaterial3D to a PrimitiveMesh and the exact same error.
However, using surface_set_material on PrimativeMesh does work.

Next I tired modifying the property hint to only be "StandardMaterial3D" and it worked.

So it appears it maybe a problem with PROPERTY_HINT_RESOURCE_TYPE when it is used to check for two different types (sorry if I got terminology wrong but I barely know what I'm looking at).

Confirmed again on the latest master, found while trying to port some of the demos to master.

![Screenshot from 2021-06-07 23-35-23](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1646875/121119392-85247b00-c7e9-11eb-9897-3a69c11ea515.png)

Got caught by this, too.
I used
```gdscript
mesh["material_override"] = material
```
as a workaround. (Or use .set("material_override"), if we want to keep the bracket syntax hidden 😄)

review_comments: `get_return_info()` is only enabled with `DEBUG_METHODS_ENABLED`, so this doesn't compile for all platforms/targets.
It just occurred to me that we need to enable some of those things on release builds too. Otherwise typed GDScript won't be working correctly and will miss a bunch of optimizations.
